title: Email & alerts
subtitle: Choose who receives each email. Staff are emailed only at a verified personal address; everyone else gets the alert on their phone and in the bell.
adminOnly: Only an administrator can change who receives emails.
mandatory: Cannot be turned off by staff
externalHint: Up to 10, separated by commas. For example an insurer or the accident mailbox. They see no driver names, notes or money.
includeAssignee: Also email the person the work is assigned to
saveError: Could not save. Check the addresses and try again.
testSent: Test queued to your verified address.
testNoAddress: You do not have a verified email address yet. Add one under Security & account.
testError: Could not queue the test email.
